title: Признак «море»: проверка на данных мест
goal: Найти и проверить детерминированный признак «море», отличающий море/океан от озёр (включая крупные и низкие), водохранилищ и рек по данным места; итог — summary.json по контракту S1 и вердикт works.

accept.name: sea_places
accept.cmd: python3 -c "import json;print('n', sum(p['kind']=='sea' for p in json.load(open('tools/research/sea_mask/summary.json'))['places']))"

accept.name: inland_places
accept.cmd: python3 -c "import json;print('n', sum(p['kind'] in ('lake','reservoir','river') for p in json.load(open('tools/research/sea_mask/summary.json'))['places']))"

accept.name: dead_sea_lake
accept.cmd: python3 -c "import json;ps=json.load(open('tools/research/sea_mask/summary.json'))['places'];print('dead', sum(1 for p in ps if p['kind']=='lake' and abs(p['lat']-31.5)<0.5 and abs(p['lon']-35.5)<0.5 and p['sea_cells']==0))"

accept.name: dead_sea_edge
accept.cmd: python3 -c "import json;ps=json.load(open('tools/research/sea_mask/summary.json'))['places'];print('dse', sum(1 for p in ps if p['kind']=='lake' and abs(p['lat']-(31.4))<0.3 and abs(p['lon']-(36.35))<0.3 and p['touches_edge'] and p['sea_cells']==0))"

accept.name: salton_edge
accept.cmd: python3 -c "import json;ps=json.load(open('tools/research/sea_mask/summary.json'))['places'];print('sal', sum(1 for p in ps if p['kind']=='lake' and abs(p['lat']-(33.3))<0.3 and abs(p['lon']-(-114.9))<0.3 and p['touches_edge'] and p['sea_cells']==0))"
